bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to elections; clarifying employment status of election judges; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 204B.19, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 204B.19, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 7.+]

[+Employment status of election judges.+]

[+Nothing in this section establishes that an election judge is an employee of an appointing authority. No appointing authority shall, as a condition of appointment as an election judge, require that an individual be subject to requirements by the appointing authority that are unrelated to the ability of an individual to perform the duties of an election judge or that may otherwise be required as a condition of employment for a permanent employee of the appointing authority. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to elections; clarifying employment status of election judges; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 204B.19, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 204B.19, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 7.

Employment status of election judges.

Nothing in this section establishes that an election judge is an employee of an appointing authority. No appointing authority shall, as a condition of appointment as an election judge, require that an individual be subject to requirements by the appointing authority that are unrelated to the ability of an individual to perform the duties of an election judge or that may otherwise be required as a condition of employment for a permanent employee of the appointing authority.
additions: Nothing in this section establishes that an election judge is an employee of an appointing authority. No appointing authority shall, as a condition of appointment as an election judge, require that an individual be subject to requirements by the appointing authority that are unrelated to the ability of an individual to perform the duties of an election judge or that may otherwise be required as a condition of employment for a permanent employee of the appointing authority.
